2. Time mode
In the Time mode of this basketball game the player needs to shoot, keeping the time in mind. Every time the ball falls into the basket when the player shoots, he gains extra time to shoot the balls.

3. Distance mode
In the distance mode goal is to shoot successfully from the longest possible distance.
